scope: synthetic OIDC issuer; real isolated PostgreSQL, compiled API and production Next browser

checks.name: real API rejects absent, expired and tampered authentication
organization/app ownership and token roles confer no platform authority
durable operator roles allow bounded inspection without provider/session disclosure
independent review pins configuration and cannot activate a client
ended browser session cannot reuse an otherwise valid operator token
production console never discloses directory data without a session
production console denies an ordinary organization owner
operator console renders actual directory and reviewed app on narrow and wide screens
native browser review is CSRF protected and recorded without activation
reader cannot submit reviews and operator revocation takes effect with the same bearer
